player_prompt.intro:
Ni wewe Mugenzi {player_id}. Ukinzwe Umukino wa Kubuka.
Icyo ukeneye ni kuganisha impeta z'ibitabo ku isahani, zirenze uwo mukinana wawe.
Ku mukino wawe, hitamo ibitabo bibiri ugahindure kwa kwinjiza nambari za safu na za kugira ibitabo bya mbere na bya kabiri, nk' '[0 1 1 0]', aho ibitabo bya mbere biri ku safu 0 na ku gira 1, na ibitabo bya kabiri biri ku safu 1 na ku gira 0.
Ikiwa ibitabo byombi bimurika, woweza agahigo na ibitabo bikomeye wambaye. Ikiwa bitamurika, ibitabo birahinduka inyuma, urugero '.'.
Umukino urangira iyo impeta zose zaramurikwa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Imyitozo idakwiriye. Umukinnyi {player_id} ntabwo yasubije n'amabwiriza yemewe mu nkingi z'imfuruka.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Intego ibi. Umukinnyi {player_id} yatoranije ahantu hatari mu karere.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Umukino udafite agaciro. Umukinnyi {player_id} yatoranyije ikarita imwe inshuro ebyiri.
invalid_move.already_matched: Kugenda kwa Mugenzi {player_id} kutabaye. Yatoye ikarita imwe cyangwa zombi zikaba zamurikwa.

game_message.cards_match: Ibitabo byatoye na Mugenzi {player_id} ku ntego [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] byamurika!
game_message.cards_no_match: Ibitabo byatoye na Mugenzi {player_id} ntibimurika. Ibitabo ku ntego [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} na {pos2} mtawali.

outcome.draw: Abakinnyi bombi bahuriye ku mubare umwe w'amakarita.
outcome.turn_limit: Mipaka ya mzunguko imeridhika. Mchezo umemaliza. Mwamuzi 0 amepata pointi {score_0}, Mwamuzi 1 amepata pointi {score_1}.
